# Traceability flow

The canonical artifact is generated at `.quarto-needs/needs.json` before rendering. The graph can traverse needs, requirements, architecture decisions, architecture, tests, and evidence without changing data models.

{{< need-flow root="STK-001" depth="5" relations="derives-from;addresses;applies-to;implemented-by;verified-by;confirmed-by;evidenced-by;mitigates" direction="LR" >}}

## CLI query

```bash
quarto-needs check
quarto-needs coverage
quarto-needs trace STK-001
quarto-needs trace ADR-002
```

An architecture decision acts as a semantic bridge between problem and solution: `addresses` points to the driver, `applies-to` bounds architectural scope, and `confirmed-by` records how the decision continues to be demonstrated.

## Interactive graph

The projection below is generated during the build and rendered in the browser with vendored Cytoscape.js, without network access. Use search to locate a requirement or ADR by ID/title, then select a node to highlight its neighborhood.
